 Hamza, Shamit give Bangladesh 2-0 lead at half-time
 Published : 11 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 11 November 2026, 22:20
 • 
 FOOTBALL
 SHARE 
 Star Sports Report 
 Shamit Shome celebrates his opening goal against Sri Lanka. Photo: Firoz Ahmed 
 Shamit Shome and Hamza Choudhury scored a goal apiece as Bangladesh took a comfortable 2-0 lead at half-time in their final Group A fixture of the SAFF Championship against Sri Lanka at the National Stadium in Dhaka on Wednesday. 
 Shamit gave Bangladesh the perfect start with a volley from inside the box after capitalising on a rebound. The New York Cosmos midfielder collected the ball after Sri Lanka goalkeeper Sujan Perera punched away Hamza's cross. His first attempt was blocked by Christopher Kelly, but Shamit found space to slot home the rebound. It was his second international goal for Bangladesh, both scored at the same venue.

 Hamza, operating at an advanced central midfield role, came close to scoring a spectacular goal after controlling a Rakib Hossain header inside the box before attempting an audacious back-heel flick. The effort missed the target by a few feet, with Perera out of position.
 Hamza grabbed the second goal for the team and the fifth of his Bangladesh career two minutes before the break when he calmly slotted home Mohammad Ibrahim's lay-off, with the ball finding the back of the net despite the goalkeeper getting a touch.
